cases.sentence: Неравенство супругов, по его мнению, состояло в том, что неверность жены и неверность мужа казнятся неравно и законом и ___.
cases.explain: «общественным мнением» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: When they rose from the table and the ladies had gone out, Pestsov did not follow them, but addressing Alexey Alexandrovitch, began to expound the chief ground of inequality. The inequality in marriage, in his opinion, lay in the fact that the infidelity of the wife and the infidelity of the husband are punished unequally, both by the law and by public opinion. Stepan Arkadyevitch went hurriedly up to Alexey Alexandrovitch and offered him a cigar.

cases.sentence: – Я не верю, не верю, не могу верить этому! – сжимая пред собой свои ___, с энергичным жестом проговорила Долли.
cases.explain: «костлявые руки» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “I don’t believe it, I don’t believe it, I can’t believe it!” Dolly said, clasping her bony hands before her with a vigorous gesture. She rose quickly, and laid her hand on Alexey Alexandrovitch’s sleeve. “We shall be disturbed here. Come this way, please.”

cases.sentence: Алексей Александрович холодно улыбнулся одними губами, желая показать ей и самому себе твердость своего убеждения; но эта ___, хотя и не колебала его, растравляла его рану.
cases.explain: «горячая защита» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Alexey Alexandrovitch smiled coldly, with his lips alone, meaning to signify to her and to himself the firmness of his conviction; but this warm defense, though it could not shake him, reopened his wound. He began to speak with greater heat.

cases.sentence: Лицо его покраснело пятнами, и ___ глядели прямо на нее.
cases.explain: «мутные глаза» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “I have thought, Darya Alexandrovna, I have thought a great deal,” said Alexey Alexandrovitch. His face turned red in patches, and his dim eyes looked straight before him. Darya Alexandrovna at that moment pitied him with all her heart. “That was what I did indeed when she herself made known to me my humiliation; I left everything as of old. I gave her a chance to reform, I tried to save her. And with what result? She would not regard the slightest request—that she should observe decorum,” he said, getting heated. “One may save anyone who does not want to be ruined; but if the whole nature is so corrupt, so depraved, that ruin itself seems to be her salvation, what’s to be done?”

cases.explain: «ничьей женой» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “No, it is awful! She will be no one’s wife, she will be lost!”

cases.sentence: Воспоминание о ___ жены так раздражило его, что он опять стал холоден, как и при начале разговора. – Я очень вас благодарю за ваше участие, но мне пора, – сказал он, вставая.
cases.explain: «последнем проступке» — after the preposition «о», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “What can I do?” said Alexey Alexandrovitch, raising his shoulders and his eyebrows. The recollection of his wife’s last act had so incensed him that he had become frigid, as at the beginning of the conversation. “I am very grateful for your sympathy, but I must be going,” he said, getting up.
